Residence renewal for family members of foreign residents
Search in Services
Start service
This service enables the possibility of renewing a residence permit for a foreign national's family members under the same terms as when it was originally issued.
Service Details
Collapse All
Requirements
1. A recent coloured personal photo with a white background for the sponsored person.
2. A copy of the passport.
3. The concerned authorities approve a decent medical examination if they are over the age of (18) years old.
Service Steps
Digital channels (website/smart application):
1. Log in to the smart services system through (UAE Pass or username).
2. Search for the service to be applied for.
3. Fill in the application data, where applicable.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).

Customer Happiness Center:
1. Visit the nearest Customer Happiness Center.
2. Get the automated turn ticket and wait.
3. Submitting the application that fulfils all conditions and documents (if any) to the customer service employee.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).

Amer Service Center:
1. Visit the nearest Amer Service Center.
2. Get the automated turn ticket and wait.
3. Submitting the application that fulfils all conditions and documents (if any) to the customer service employee.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).
Fees
Residency permit renewal fee: AED200

Extra charge :
Knowledge Dirham: AED10
Innovation Dirham: AED10
Fee inside the country: AED500

Delivery:
AED20


Note The issuance fee increases by AED100 for each year whenever the residency is more than two years.
Terms And Conditions
Not Applicant
Service Availability Channels
Digital channels (website/smart application):

Amer Service Center:
The service is available during the normal operating hours of AMER Centers
Expected Completion Time
48.0 Hour(s)
Additional Information
The grace period for staying inside the country after the expiry of the residence permit or cancellation is (60) sixty days.
Related Services
1. Amendment of all types of residence permit data. 2. Cancellation of all types of residence permits.

Amendment of all types of residence permit data
Search in Services
Start service
This service allows data amendment for residency visa
Service Details
Collapse All
Requirements
1- A recent personal photo with a white background for the sponsored person
2- Sponsored person's passport
Service Steps
GDRFA Website:
1. Login to the website
2. Register a new user account (in case there is no account)
3. Select the required service
4. Attach the required documents
5. Pay the fees due for the service
6. Submit the application

AMER Center
1. Head to one of AMER service centers
2. Select the required service at the receptionist
3. Submit the required documents to the service employee
4. Pay the fees due for the service
5. Submit the application
6. Receive approval by SMS
7. Visit one of the GDRFA branches to stamp the visa

Note: a text message + an email is sent to the customer with the status of the application:
• If there are missing documents on the application, the customer is notified of the need to attach the missing documents within 30 days, and if the missing documents are not attached, the application will be cancelled
• In case there are no missing documents in the application, the customer will be notified of the approval and
Fees
* Urgent service fee AED 100
* Innovation fee AED 10
* Printing fee AED 100 (in case of submission through (ZAJEL Courier Center)
Terms And Conditions
1. Passport must be valid for more than six months
2. In case of investor and partner: establishment card must be presented
3. In case the sponsor is a government sector: a letter of change of profession must be submitted
4. In case the sponsor is a private sector: a labour contract or Employment ID must be submit
Service Availability Channels
GDRFA Website:
The service is available 24/7

AMER Centers:
The service is available during the normal operating hours of AMER Centers
Expected Completion Time
Additional Information
This service has no additional information

Issuance of a residence permit for foreigner family members
Search in Services
Start service
Both male and female foreign residents are allowed to bring their family members into the country, including the husband and any children under 25 or unmarried daughters. Following the regulations, children with special needs may also be brought in regardless of age. The family will reside where the guarantor/head of the family does for the duration of the agreement.
Service Details
Collapse All
Requirements
1. A recent colour photograph with a white background for the sponsored person.
2. Copy of passport.
3. A decent medical examination approved by the concerned authorities if they are over (18) years old.
Service Steps
Digital channels (website/smart application):
1. Log in to the smart services system through (UAE Pass or username).
2. Search for the service to be applied for.
3. Fill in the application data, where applicable.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).
Customer Happiness Centre:
1. Visit the nearest Customer Happiness Centre.
2. Get the automated turn ticket and wait.
3. Submitting the application that fulfils all conditions and documents (if any) to the customer service employee.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).

Amer Service Centre:
1. Visit the nearest Amer Service Centre.
2. Get the automated turn ticket and wait.
3. Submitting the application that fulfils all conditions and documents (if any) to the customer service employee.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).

• In case there are no missing documents in the application, the customer will be notified of the approval and the approved application will be sent by e-mail.
Fees
Residence permit fee: AED200

Extra charge :
Knowledge Dirham: AED10
Innovation Dirham: AED10
Fee inside the country: AED500

Delivery:
AED20


Note The issuance fee increases by AED100 annually whenever the residency is over two years.
Terms And Conditions
1. The Dubai Future Foundation in Dubai nominates this category.
2. The entrepreneur must have a pioneering project registered with the Ministry of Economy or the competent local authorities with an income of (1 million Dirhams annually).
3. Providing suitable housing for family members.
4. Proof of kinship.
Service Availability Channels
Digital channels (website/smart application):
The service is available 24/7

Amer Service Centre:
The service is available during the normal operating hours of AMER Centers
Expected Completion Time
48.0 Hour(s)
Additional Information
The grace period to stay inside the country after the expiration of the residence permit or its cancellation is (60) days.
Related Services
There is no related services

Issuing a visit visa for a relative or friend for one entry
Search in Services
Start service
The foreigner is granted a single-entry visa for the purpose of visiting a relative or friend without a sponsor / host in UAE for a period of (30-60-90) days.

Service Details
Collapse All
Requirements
1. Two (2) personal photo.
2. A copy of the passport, and its validity should not be less than 6 months.
3.Marriage contract.
4. Birth certificate.
5. Salary certificate for governmental and semi-governmental entities and free zones / employment contract for private companies / partnership contract for the partner.

Identity card for the country of origin for some nationalities (Iraq - Pakistan - Iran - Afghanistan).

Service Steps
Digital channels (GDRFA website / smart application):
1. Login to the smart services system using (UAE pass or username).
2. Search for your required service.
3. Fill out the application information where applicable.
4. Pay the service fees (if any).

Customer Happiness Center:
1- Visit the nearest customer happiness center.
2- Obtain an automatic queue ticket.
3- Submit the application fulfilling all conditions and documents (if any) to the customer service employee.
4- Pay the service fees (if any).
AMER Service Center:
1. Visit the nearest customer happiness center.
2. Get an automated queue ticket.
3. Submit the application fulfilling all conditions and documents (if any) to the customer service employee.

Pay the service fees (if any).

Fees
- 30-day visit visa fee: AED 200.
- 60-day visit visa fee: AED 300.
- 90-day visit visa fee: AED 400.
- In addition to value added tax (5%).
- Financial security deposit: security deposit amount: AED 1000.
- Security deposit service fee: AED 20.
- Security deposit collection and reimbursement fee: AED 40.
- Medical insurance: 30-day visit visa insurance: AED 40.
- 60-day visit visa insurance: AED 60.
- 90-day visit visa insurance: AED 90.
- Additional fees (if the sponsored person is inside UAE):
Knowledge Dirham: AED 10.
Innovation Dirham: AED 10.
Fee inside UAE: AED 500.

Note: The total amount of the visa may vary more or less depending on the circumstances surrounding the sponsored person or any other reasons that may require the same.

Terms And Conditions
1- The visitor should be a relative or friend of a citizen or foreigner residing in UAE.
2. Attach proof of relationship and justifications for the visit.
3. payment of the financial security deposit determined according to the purpose.
4. If the purpose of entry is for the foreign wife to visit her husband who is a citizen of the Gulf Cooperation Council state, she should be licensed to have a valid residence permit in the country whose nationality the husband holds.

Service Availability Channels
The digital channels (GDRFA website / smart application):
The service is available 24/7.
AMER Centres: The service is available during the official working hours approved at the center

Expected Completion Time
48.0 Hour(s)
Additional Information
Not Applicant

A foreigner is provided with a visit visa to explore employment opportunities for one or more visits without requiring a host or guarantor within the country.
Service Details
Collapse All
Requirements
1. A personal photo.
2. A passport copy, valid for at least 6 months.
3. A university degree.
Service Steps
Digital channels (website/smart application):
1. Log in to the smart services system through (UAE Pass or username).
2. Search for the service to be applied for.
3. Fill in the application data, where applicable.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).
Customer Happiness Centre:

2. Get the automated turn ticket and wait.
3. Submitting the application that fulfils all conditions and documents (if any) to the customer service employee.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).

Start service
The foreigner is granted an entry visa for a single visit for the purpose of tourism for a period of 30 or 60 days, and the sponsor / host in UAE should be one of the establishments working in the field of tourism, after paying the prescribed fee and financial security deposit.

Service Details
Collapse All
Requirements
1. One personal photo.
2. Copy of the passport.
3. Identity card for the country of origin for some nationalities (Iraq - Pakistan - Iran - Afghanistan).

Service Steps
The digital channels (GDRFA website / smart application):
1. Login to the smart services system using (UAE pass or username)
2. Search for your required service.
3. Fill out the application information where applicable.

4. Pay the service fees (if any).

Fees
- 30-day tourist visa fee: AED 200.
- 60-day tourist visa fee: AED 300.
- In addition to value added tax (5%).
- Security deposit: There is no security deposit amount on this type of visa
- Additional fees (if the sponsored person is inside UAE):
Knowledge Dirham: AED 10.
Innovation Dirham: AED 10.
Fee inside UAE: 500 Dirhams.

Note: Total amount may vary. The visa may increase or decrease depending on the circumstances surrounding the sponsored person or any other reasons that may require the same.

Terms And Conditions
1. A valid and approved passport or travel document to enter UAE and return to the country in which the passport or document holder is resident or from which the passport or document was issued. The validity period of the passport or travel document should not be less than (6) six months.
2. A travel ticket to continue his journey or a ticket to leave UAE.

3. Medical insurance valid in UAE.

Service Availability Channels
Digital channels (website/smart application): The service is available 24/7

Expected Completion Time
48.0 Hour(s)
Additional Information
Only accredited tourism offices in the emirate can issue this kind of visa.

Establishment Card for Institutions in the Private Sector/ Free Zone
Search in Services
Start service
With the help of this service, private sector businesses or free zones can get an establishment card with information about the business on it.
Service Details
Collapse All
Requirements
1. A copy of the appendix of the names of the partners.
2. Passport copies of the authorised signatories.
3. A copy of the authorisation certified by the notary public for the authorised persons (in the case of a manager).

Service Steps
Digital channels (website/smart application):
1. Log in to the smart services system through (UAE Pass or username).
2. Search for the service to be applied for.
3. Fill in the application data, where applicable.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).

Customer Happiness Centres:
1. Visit the nearest Customer Happiness Centres.
2. Get the automated turn ticket and wait.
3. Submitting the application that fulfils all conditions and documents (if any) to the customer service employee.
4. Pay the service fee (if any).
Fees
Fee for issuing an establishment card: AED200
Plus VAT (5%)

Extra charge:
Knowledge Dirham: AED10
Innovation Dirham: AED10
Service fee: AED50
Urgent fee: AED100

*If the application is submitted through Amer Centres, a fee of AED100 will be added.

Note: The issuance or renewal fee is AED100 per year.
Terms And Conditions
For airlines:
1. A copy of the trade license.

For fishing boats:
1. A statement "licence" from the Ministry of Environment and Fisheries is required.

For Excursion boats/commercial boats:
2. Hunting license.

For Abra/ Yacht :
1. Ownership from the Transportation Authority.

For stables:
1. Copy of the owner’s passport with the signature form.
2. Letter from (the engineering office of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed) affiliated to Ruler’s Court of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum (Diwan Dubai) in case the stable belongs to the ruler of the emirate.
3. In case the stable is owned by an individual (a letter from the municipality with the number of horses or passports of horses).

For charities / Quran memorisation centres:
1. License from the Community Development Authority.

For Livestock Farm:
1. A copy of the owner’s passport and the signature form.
2. A letter from the municipality stating that the owner has livestock.

For property:
1. Ownership issued by (the Department of Lands and Properties).
2. property map.

For hotels:
1. A letter from the Department of Tourism with the hotel rating.
2. A letter from the hotel stating the number of rooms and hotel rating.

For consulates:
1. A no-objection letter from the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs with permission granted to the consulate.
2- An official letter from the consulate stating that the members.
3- Consulate card.

For churches:
1- A letter of no objection to practising the activity from Dubai Municipality.

For farms:
1. A copy of the owner’s passport along with the signature form.
2. Ownership issued by (the Department of Lands and Properties).

For organisations:
1- An official letter from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs

For clubs:
1. Decree from the Court (Diwan) for cultural and social clubs
2. Federal Decree (for sports clubs).

For Yachts:
1. Ownership from the Ministry of Transportation
2. expired establishment card.

Quran memorisation centres:
1. expired establishment card
2. A license from the Community Development Authority

Service Availability Channels
-Main GDRFA-Dubai Building:
The service is available during the normal operating hours of Main GDRFA-Dubai Building
-Amer Service Centre:
The service is available during the normal operating hours of AMER Centers

Expected Completion Time
48.0 Hour(s)
Additional Information
Not Applicant
Related Services
1. Renewing an establishment card. 2. Modify the data of an established card. 3. Cancellation of facility card data.
